question: Which of the following molecules has at least a 90º angle ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: H2O -> "bent molecular geometry" -> "bond angle of approximately 104.5º" -> 95%
CHAIN: NH3 -> "trigonal pyramidal molecular geometry" -> "bond angle of approximately 107º" -> 90%
CHAIN: CH4 -> "tetrahedral molecular geometry" -> "bond angle of 109.5º" -> 90%
CHAIN: SF4 -> "seesaw molecular geometry" -> "bond angles of approximately 102º and 87º" -> 80%
CHAIN: BF3 -> "trigonal planar molecular geometry" -> "bond angle of 120º" -> 90%
analysis: The molecular geometry of H2O is bent with an angle of approximately 104.5º, NH3 has a trigonal pyramidal shape with an angle of about 107º, CH4 has a tetrahedral geometry with bond angles of 109.5º, SF4 has a seesaw shape with bond angles less than 90º and greater than 120º, and BF3 has a trigonal planar shape with bond angles of 120º. Therefore, H2O, NH3, CH4, and BF3 all have angles greater than 90º, but SF4 does not. The question asks for at least a 90º angle, so the correct options are H2O, NH3, CH4, and BF3.
